ModuleMetaData.DescriptionHeadline: OGRE VRML converter: converts VRML 2 files to .mesh
ModuleMetaData.DescriptionDetails: OgreVRMLConverter of OGRE 14.6.3, a command line tool that converts VRML 2 (.wrl) files to the native .mesh format, with the vrmllib that comes with it. It runs without a render system.
